title: A report that names nothing it shows is asked, the next-question labels are explained and set aside, and the five kinds of help are counted
request: The owner: fix the one Home miss (a prediction worded like a report), look into the weak next-question labels before any model trains on them, and fix the kinds of help that showed no runs and no training examples.
spec: Home asks before routing a report whose words name nothing it shows; the reason Claude and Home disagree on the next question is found and the labels are not trained on until it is fixed; the analysis, preparation, reporting, business and advice tracks' data is found or captured.
plan: Reproduce the miss from the dev person p-03 and the sealed s-04
A code check on the intent reading, test first, then a live dev check of p-03
Study the 144 next-question labels with Claude's own thinking
Record which questions are settled; tell the labeller what each fact means; keep the old labels as readings only
Find why the five tracks count nothing; link the conversations to their drafts; record the kept Home runs
Rebuild the sets and the coverage, record, commit

decisions.decision: The check is code's, on any reading, the model's included
decisions.why: both the rules (confidence 1.0) and the model read 'some kind of weekly report on our subscribers' as a clear report; the owner's rule is that the model reads and code checks

decisions.decision: A report is clear only when its words name something it shows: a measure, a count, a rate, or a breakdown by a dimension
decisions.why: p-03's director wanted a Monday list of who will cancel; a measure word is what separates 'a weekly report of churn by region' from 'some kind of weekly report'

decisions.decision: Claude's next-question answers become readings for evaluation, never labels
decisions.why: they were made from a view that hid which questions were settled and named the absence of a labels file 'labels: unknown'; relabelling the old records would not help, since they lack the new facts

decisions.decision: Per-question flags in the state, not a list of field codes
decisions.why: the ledger's token format allows no underscore, and a flag per question is what a classifier reads best

decisions.decision: The track's conversations are linked by their draft id, with the row's own track as the coverage's fallback
decisions.why: 166 conversations existed; only their provenance lacked the draft, so they were counted as no request

change: dclab_rnd.draft.intent: REPORT_CONTENT and read() asks a reporting reading that names nothing it shows (rules v5). dclab_core 0.144.0: ledger state flags action_known, costs_known, data_plan_known, entity_known, labels_known, budget_known, family_known and the count declined; dclab_rnd.ledger.capture records them for workflow.next_question. dclab_rnd.store.routing_labels: FACT_MEANINGS shown to the labeller. dclab_rnd.store.sets.routing: NOT_LABELS keeps Claude's next-question answers as readings. dclab_rnd.store.sets.llm: a Home conversation's provenance names its draft and project. dclab_rnd.store.coverage: a row's own track as the fallback. dclab_rnd.agent_eval.home and its conversation eval: kept runs open a session log.

findings.defect: A prediction worded as a report was routed at once to reporting
findings.scenario: Dev person p-03 and sealed s-04: 'I need some kind of weekly report on our subscribers'; the person wanted a list of the customers who will cancel next month; Home routed reporting with no question
findings.cause: the rules read the generic report words as a stated reporting request (confidence 1.0) and the model agreed; nothing checked that the report named anything it shows
findings.fix: a reporting reading whose words name no measure, count, rate or breakdown is asked, so the understanding conversation runs first

findings.defect: Claude's next-question labels agreed with Home only 47 times in 144
findings.scenario: Claude picked 'labels' 15 times where Home asked the action, and 9 where Home asked the outcome; its thinking named the open question as the one fact the view showed unknown
findings.cause: the state showed only whether the outcome and the moment were known, and 'labels: unknown' meant only that no labels file was uploaded
findings.fix: the state records every question's flag and the declined count; the labeller is shown what each fact means; the old labels are readings only

findings.defect: Five kinds of help showed no training example
findings.scenario: The coverage said analysis, preparation, reporting, business and advice had no run and no training example, while 166 of their conversations sat in m4's track sets
findings.cause: a draft file's store record names no draft, so each conversation's provenance had none and the coverage filed it under no request
findings.fix: the conversation's provenance names its draft and project; the coverage falls back to the row's own track

findings.defect: The kept Home test runs recorded no run
findings.scenario: Home's dev runs and conversation runs kept their drafts and decisions but no session log, so no run.recorded reached the store for any track
findings.cause: the kept folders installed a ledger but never a session log
findings.fix: both evals open a session log in each kept folder and put the earlier one back

findings.defect: A Home test expected no open question after a declined one
findings.scenario: test_home_not_known: after 'I don't know' to the budget, Home now asks the next open question
findings.cause: since 2026-10-29 Home is never silent: an empty model turn goes on to the next question
findings.fix: the test checks that the declined question is never the one open

findings.defect: The report check asked many clear reports, every Persian one included
findings.scenario: The first word list opened 30 of the 77 reporting requests the rules read right in the written sets: reports rebuilt by hand, content named in other words, column names with underscores, Persian requests
findings.cause: an English-only list matched with word boundaries that treat an underscore as a letter, and no notion of a report that already exists
findings.fix: letter boundaries, a wider content list with breakdowns, a report that exists counts as named, Persian not judged here

findings.defect: The kept runs' session log went to PostgreSQL under a made-up workspace
findings.scenario: With DCLAB_DATABASE_URL set, every event of a kept Home run failed and the folder held none
findings.cause: open_log returns a PostgreSQL log when a database is configured
findings.fix: a file log in the kept folder, as the ledger already was

findings.defect: Home's decide tool served the next-question state without the new flags
findings.scenario: A classifier trained on records with the flags was asked by Home's decide tool with a state lacking them
findings.cause: chat._problem_state built its own copy of the state

findings.defect: The labeller's next-question thinking could still become training reasoning
findings.scenario: A person-labelled next-question row where Claude's blind answer agreed: the chat export took Claude's thinking as the reason; and the labeller's exchanges entered m4 as report examples
findings.cause: chat_row took any model reading with the same answer; the m4 builder mapped the labeller's purpose to the report stage
findings.fix: chat_row skips the labeller's reading on NOT_LABELS points; the labeller's exchanges are no m4 examples (NOT_WORKFLOW)

measurements.name: p-03 live, dev
measurements.gate: the conversation gate v2 on the one dev person who was missed
measurements.result: routed prediction after two turns of talk; gate v2 passes; EUR 0.04
limits: one person; the sealed set is spent and was not run again

measurements.name: harness suite after the intent change
measurements.gate: every regression case and dev journey right on every step

measurements.name: next-question label study
measurements.gate: a reason for the disagreement found in Claude's own thinking before any model trains on the labels
measurements.result: 47 agreements in 144; the main pairs action against labels and outcome against labels; the view hid the settled questions

measurements.name: report check on the written sets
measurements.gate: no reporting request the rules read right is asked; the missed persons still asked
measurements.result: 0 of 77 asked (30 before the review's fix); p-03's opening still asked

outcome: Home asks what a vague report should show before routing; the next-question labels are explained and kept out of training until records with the new facts are labelled; the five kinds of help are counted from their conversations, and kept Home runs are recorded. The tracks' data is still test traffic: real people's sessions are what they need.
lessons: A clear-looking reading can be wrong when the words name no content: check what the request asks to see
Read the labeller's own thinking before trusting its labels: it says what it could not see
Data missing from a count may be present and unlinked: check the provenance before capturing more
risks: The report content words are a list: a report naming its content in other words is asked once more than needed
The five tracks still have no real person's data
